observation.visible_scene: A black Sony 5-disc CD changer sits on a dark surface with its disc tray pulled open toward the camera. The left tray pocket holds a yellow-and-black 'ATLANTIC' disc; the right tray pocket is initially empty. A white paper and a teal object rest behind the unit. The front LCD shows track/time readouts and a disc grid.
visible_changes: Frames 1-13: the scene is static with only the yellow disc loaded; the LCD time advances from 0.04 to 0.05.
Frame 14: a hand holding a red-and-purple 'Captain Fantastic' disc enters from the right edge of frame.
Frames 15-19: the hand translates the red disc leftward and downward, aligning it over the empty right tray pocket.
Frames 20-34: the hand lowers the disc into the right pocket and the fingers press/adjust it to seat it flat; the LCD time advances 0.05 to 0.07.
Frames 35-38: the hand releases the disc and withdraws rightward out of the tray area.
Frames 39-41: the hand is gone; both discs now occupy the left and right tray pockets, tray still open.
outside_clip_unknowns: What happens after the tray closes or whether the changer loads the discs is not shown.
How the yellow disc was originally placed is not shown.
The reason for the LCD number changes is not visible.
uncertain_details: Exact moment the disc becomes fully seated is hard to pinpoint due to finger occlusion.
Whether the LCD increments reflect playback or a separate timer is not determinable from the clip alone.
